title: CBDT Issues Form 98 Filing Procedure Under New Income-tax Rules, 2026
content:
# CBDT Issues Form 98 Filing Procedure Under New Income-tax Rules, 2026

Ek important update hai! Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne Form 98 ki filing ke liye naye procedures announce kiye hain under Rule 160 of the Income-tax Rules, 2026. Yeh notification Director General of Income-tax (Systems) dwara jaari kiya gaya hai.

Here's a quick rundown of what you need to know:

*   **Notification Reference:** The procedure has been prescribed vide **Notification No. 3 of 2026 dated September 15, 2026**.
*   **Purpose of Form 98:** Rule 160 specifies that certain persons or entities who receive declarations in Form No. 97 (related to transactions covered under Rule 159) must furnish a statement in Form No. 98 through online electronic data transmission.
*   **Key Due Dates for Filing Form 98:**
    *   **Declarations received by September 30:** These must be furnished by October 31 of that year.
    *   **Declarations received by March 31:** These need to be furnished by April 30 of the financial year immediately following the year in which the form was received.
*   **Registration Process:** Reporting persons/entities ko e-filing website (https://eportal.incometax.gov.in) par register karna hoga to generate an Income Tax Department Reporting Entity Identification Number (ITDREIN).
*   **No Re-registration for Form 61 Filers:** Jo entities pehle se Form No. 61 ke liye registered hain, unhein Form No. 98 ke liye dobara register karne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Unka existing ITDREIN aur principal officers valid rahenge.
*   **Verification:** Form No. 98 ke verification ke liye, principal officer "Designated Director" ke roop mein act karenge.
*   **Utilities:** The prescribed Schema, Report Generation, and Validation Utility for Form No. 98, along with the Generic Submission Utility, Reporting Portal ke "Resources" tab se download ki ja sakti hain.
*   **Effective Date:** This new procedure is effective from September 15, 2026.
*   **Past Reporting:** Financial Year 2025-26 aur usse pehle ke years ke liye reporting (including corrections/deletions) Income-tax Act, 1961 aur Income-tax Rules, 1962 ke provisions ke according Form No. 61 ke through hi continue hogi, as per Notification No. 2 of 2018 dated April 5, 2018.

This is a crucial compliance update. Make sure your systems and procedures are aligned with these new requirements!

*Published on: 17 September 2026*
